system.description: Vines coil like snakes across a 20' radius at a point within 30'. Sustained.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and every creature inside when the vines erupt is Restrained until the start of its next turn.
outcomes.success: The area is difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn inside takes d4 damage. A creature that tries to leave is Restrained until the start of its next turn unless it tears free (a player character tests Strength DR12; for a foe, the Dark Master rolls a d20 and it tears free on 12 or higher).
outcomes.failure: The area is difficult terrain until the end of your next turn, and nothing more.
outcomes.ruin: The vines take your ankles: you are Restrained until the end of your next turn. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
